utterances.text: No. Hold on a second let me see what is up.

utterances.text: Ok looks like I am going to need the Uber at 8:30 now. Headed across town to that new Fusion Steak House with the new guy from work.

utterances.text: Ok give me a second.

utterances.text: You always look nice.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Thank you. I remember a time when it was so much easier to pick out clothes.

utterances.text: Why is that?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Oh youth is wasted on the young my dear.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: If you say so, I think you are like fine wine, getting better with age.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Oh you are good. I like that.

utterances.text: Ok your Uber will be there. Same place and new time. Same car, same driver.

utterances.speaker: USER

utterances.text: I sure love Uber. They have made Taxi's a thing of the past.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I know. I hate taking a cab.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Me too. So is that all you needed tonight?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Yes, go have some fun yourself. You are off the clock my dear.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Thank you, you have fun too, your ride should be on its way soon!

utterances.text: Okay, So the fare will be around 7 dollars and 87 cents, but it could change due to traffic and waiting fees.

utterances.text: Okay that sounds good.

utterances.text: Yes you can log into your app.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Okay im glad to hear that!

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Thank you so much for your help.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Thanks you too!

utterances.speaker: USER

utterances.speaker: USER

utterances.speaker: USER

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Ok. Let me check their site.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Oh man... they're booked until 9 pm too!

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Grr. I'm actually offput by the whole thing.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT

utterances.speaker: USER

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Actually... yeah!

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Thanks, I'll have you place an order for groceries once I figure out what I want.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Ok!

utterances.speaker: USER

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Ok, and what is your pickup location?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Thank you

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Sure!

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Nope, just the ride please

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT

utterances.speaker: USER

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Alright, your reservation has been made for 8:15pm at Seven. Two people, table on the second floor. Checkin name?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Garrow.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT

utterances.speaker: USER

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: No problem! Enjoy your evening.

utterances.text: And where in convener will your destination be?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: 104 10th St NW, Conover, NC 28613

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: I understand, is this a one way trip?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Yes

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Are you wanting a regular ride or an upgrade?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Just regular please.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Sounds good I can get that set up for you.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Great, what is my estimated fare?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Sounds good, what time will my pick up be?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Details will be delivered to your email box.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Awesome thank you!

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: No problem.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Hey, I want you to order dinner from Pizza Hut

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Okay, what do you want?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I want two large pizzas.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Alright. What toppings do you want on the first one?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Get that one with sausage and onions.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Very good. And the second one?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: For the second get it with mushrooms, green peppers, and onions.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Sounds good. Anything else?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Yes, add a side order of breadsticks to that, they have the best there.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Yummy, yeah, they do have the best. Anything else?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Yes, make that sausage and onion a thin crust pizza, the other can remain the regular pan pizza.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Alright, so you want two large pizzas, one thin crust with sausage and onions and one pan with mushrooms, green peppers and onions and a side of breaksticks. Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: That's perfect.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Great. I'll get this order in and let you know the details.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Sounds good.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Okay, the order is in and it will be ready in 25 minutes.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Great, how much did it cost?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Only about $25, I used one of the coupons, so not bad at all.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Thanks, really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: No problem, that's what I'm here for.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I need to book an appointment at the auto repair shop called Intelligent Auto Solutions.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Ok. When would you like the appointment for?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: As soon as possible.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: It looks they are booked the rest of the week, so the earliest you could bring it in is this weekend.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: If that's the earliest time there is I guess I'll take it.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Is this for a tune-up or is there some other problem you need fixed?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Well the check engine light is on and the car tends to shutter when breaking.

segments.text: check engine light is on and the car tends to shutter when breaking.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Ok. I will give them that info.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: How early do they open on the weekend?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: They open at 7am and don't close until 4pm.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Ok. Tell them I will be there first thing on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: No problem. What is the make and model of the vehicle?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: It is a 2015 BMW 328i

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Ok. I will make that appointment for you for 7am this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Do you have any information about potential costs for an estimate on repairs?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: A check engine diagnostic costs $25 and a standard break job will cost between $100 and $300 depending on how many wheels need fixing. All major credit cards are accepted.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Good to know. Any idea how long this repair could take?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: They say that most repairs can be done in a day and they will call you directly when complete.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Ok. Thanks for your help.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: My pleasure.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Im lookign for a high quality Italian restaurant to eat at?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: In what city would you like to go?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I would like to find on in Miami?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Il Gabbiano is a good one.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Make me a reservation there for a party of 4 at 8pm on Friday.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Under what name would you like to make this reservation?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Under Alex Jones.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: There is a table available for that time on Friday. Is there anything else you would like with this reservation?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Can we get outdoor seating on the deck?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: The dont have a deck at this restaurant.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: What about under a canopy or umbrella?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: They have that but not for 8pm time you want. Do you still want to book it?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: No, I think I am just going to stick with Ristorante Fratelli Milano.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: You still want table for 4 at 8pm on Friday night?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Yes, thats what i would like.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Outdoor seating as well there.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Yes, I want outdoor seating if its available.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Everything is available and youre reservation is set.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: You're welcome.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Hey, I am looking for a Mexican restaurant located in Kokomo Indiana that is really good.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: There are several Mexican restaurants that have great reviews in the Kokomo area. Is there anything else important that you would like me to narrow this down with?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I would like to find one that is normally not as busy during the Sunday after church brush.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Great! It looks like Three Amigos has a pretty good dining area. I think they will be able to accommodate you around after service hours on a Sunday.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Great where is this restaurant located?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: It is located on Dickson Street. It looks like it is about five miles away from your current location.

segments.text: about five miles away from your current location

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Okay that's perfect.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Okay, what day would you like to dine at this restaurant?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: We will need that reservation April 10th around 1 pm.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Okay, would you like indoor or outdoor seating?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: We would like indoor seating please.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Okay, would you like a booth or prefer a table? And for how many guests?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: We would prefer a booth and it is for 6 guests.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: I'm sorry, it looks like they are booked up for that time slot. Would any other time work during that day?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Do they have any availability at 2 p.m.?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: They do, but it looks like you will have to sit at a table for 6. Will that be okay?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: That will be fine. Thank you

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Okay let me confirm a reservation. I have you down for April 10th at 2 p.m. It is a reservation for 6 guests at a table. I also have you going to Three Amigos located on Dixon Road in Kokomo, Indiana. Will you confirm this information please?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Yes, that is all correct! Thank you

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: You are most welcome. Three Amigos will be seeing you on April 10th at 2 p.m. I will put the reservation down under Miller, that is for 6 guests at a table. I hope you have a wonderful time.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Will you please request a ride for me?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Yes, of course. Where would you like to be picked up at?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: We are at Wild life Zoo.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: In glendale?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: And what is your destination?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: We are going to the Kabuki restaurant at Westgate.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Okay, let me check for the cars in your area.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Oh, and we just want a regular, I don't want to pay extra.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Oh, looks like there are only XL or Lux in your area now.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: How about shared ride?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: I don't see any shared either.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Oh, that's too bad...Okay I think we will go with XL.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Okay, sorry about that. I will request the ride for you.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Okay, good.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Your driver will be Mike and he is driving a Lincoln Continental.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Wow, that's fancy! Okay good.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: He should be there in about 5-6 minutes. You can track it on your phone.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Okay, I will do that, thanks again.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: You are very welcome.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Hey, I need you to place a coffee order for me to pick up from Starbucks.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: No, problem, which Starbucks did you want me to place the order at?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: The one on Lakeside and McCarran, please

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: What would you like from Starbucks?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Grab me a grande iced salted caramel mocha with almond milk. Grab something for yourself as well.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Thank you, I don't think they have that drink right now.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I just saw it on the menu online, I know they have it. Look it up for yourself and you will see it.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: If you saw it online why can't you order it?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I need you to just do what I ask.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Fine. An Iced Salted Caramel Mocha.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: With almond milk and grande

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: A grande with almond milk.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Thank you. I'll pick it up in about 15 minutes, while I am driving there.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Oh, I didn't...

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Yes, I wanted to ensure it was ready when I got there, because I am very busy.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: I apologize for assuming.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: That's okay, now I am running late so I really need you to place that order, ASAP

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: It is already placed.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Do you need me for anything else today?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: No, enjoy the rest of your day.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Thank you. You as well.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Hello, I was calling about reserving some movie tickets for the new Hellboy?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Sure thing, what city were you planning to see it in?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: At Columbus AMC Theater.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Okay, how many tickets would you like?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Two, please.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Alright, what day?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Tuesday.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Oh, I'm sorry. We have no tickets available for that movie on Tuesday, would you like Wednesday instead?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: No, that's okay. I'll just see Detective Pikachu instead that day.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Alright, same theater and number of tickets, correct?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Yes, that's right.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: What time?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Would you like to see it in 3D?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: No thanks.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Where in the theater would you like to sit?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Near the front.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Oh I'm sorry, once again we have no seats like that available at that time. Would you like to change the time?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: No, I guess I'll just reserve tickets later in the week. Thanks anyway.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: No problem! I'm sorry I couldn't be of more help.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: It's okay, goodbye.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I want to order a coffee from Starbucks.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: There are three Starbucks in the area. Which store do you prefer?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: The one on Rt. 3 in Frederickburg has the best baristas.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Great. What kind of coffee would like?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I want a Caramel Macchiato.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: What size would you like?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: It's Monday so definitely a Grande.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Would you like that made with almond milk?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: No. I like regular milk.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Is that 2% or whole milk?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I'll save a few calories and get 2%.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Would you like anything extra in your coffee like whipped cream?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: No whipped cream. I would like a double shot of espresso in it though.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: It comes with a caramel topping. Do you want that or should I have them leave it off.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: The caramel is the best part. I do want it.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: To confirm your order you would like a Grande Caramel Macchiato with 2% milk and a double shot of espresso from the Starbucks on Rt. 3 in Frederickburg. Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: That's correct.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Your drink has been ordered and will be ready for pickup at the Rt. 3 location in Fredericksburg. Your receipt will be sent to your phone via text message.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Thank you!

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: You're welcome. Is there anything else I can do for you?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: No. That is all.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Thank you and have a great morning.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Hi Tabitha! I would like to order a pizza from Pizza Hut!

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Umm, that sounds so good right now Perry! What do you want?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I would like a large Meat Love's Pizza!

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: That is great, so you want Pepperoni, Italian Sausage, Ham, bacon, season pork and beef.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Yes, that is right, especially the bacon, they have to have the bacon.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Alright, I will make sure. What size do you want?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I want a large pizza, of course!

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Oh, wait! I see a message that they are out of bacon!

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: No way! Are you joking?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: No, i wish I was joking! But they said that they can substitute it with something else.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Well, that is terrible. I guess I would like to add extra crispy pepperoni!

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Yes, that sounds like a great alternative.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Yes, that will do!

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Alright, I made the changes. Do you want anything else?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: No that is all. How much is it?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: It will be $17 plus tax.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: What? Did the price go up or something?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: I guess so! Do you want to go through with the order?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Yeah, may as well. They should give me a discount for not having the bacon!

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: No doubt! Okay, so to confirm, you will order the Pizza Hut's Meat Lover's Pizza and will add extra pepperoni in place of the bacon for $17.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Yes, that sounds like a plan!

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Alright, I have purchased it and will send you the receipt to your phone.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Excellent, thank you very much!

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: No problem and have fun eating the pizza!

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Thanks!

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Bye!

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Hi Karen, I was thinking of getting tickets to see Captain Marvel this week, if you could help me out.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Hi there, I can definitely look into tickets for you, where were you looking to see it?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I was thinking in Boston.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Ok, let me pull up some theaters in that area, when did you want to see it?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: This Friday evening, preferably around 8pm.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Great, and will you have any guests, or just you?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: It would be for myself and one friend.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Ok, I've found tickets for two around 8pm Friday at the AMC theaters at Assembly Row, Boston Common and South Bay, which would you prefer?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I would prefer the Assembly Row theater.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Great, there's a showing of Captain Marvel at Assembly Row at 8:15pm.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: That sounds great, is that one in 3D?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: No it isn't for that showing, would you like me to check the other nearby theaters?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Yes please, I'd prefer to see it in 3D.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Alright, I've found tickets for two for Captain Marvel in 3D at the Boston Common location at 8:30pm, should we book that?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Sure, how much are those tickets going to be?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: For that time and location, it looks like $27 per ticket, so $54 total.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: That seems a little high, are all the showtimes the same price?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: They do vary a little bit, there is a showing at that same location at 9pm on Friday that's a little more affordable, $22 per ticket so $44 total.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: That sounds more reasonable to me, lets book that.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Perfect, you're all set for Captain Marvel in 3D this Friday at 9pm at the AMC Boston Common for two people, tickets should be texted to your phone momentarily, was there anything else you needed?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: No that was all, thanks Karen.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: You're welcome, bye!

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Hey Larry, I need to find a restaurant for tonight. I think I'm in the mood for Italian. Can you find me something good?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. Sicilia, absolutely. There are a number of options for Capitol Hill and Belltown. Would you like me to go over them?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Let's narrow it down as much as you can, I'm sort of on a tight schedule here.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Certainly. Let me see...we have Spinasse on the Hill, and the ever-popular Pink Door near Pike Place.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I'm not sure about the Pink Door. Amy still thinks that's a strip club, and I got in trouble last time I went there. I mean, it's great, but...how about the other one. Spinache?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Spinasse, sir. It's described as upscale Italian, but in a rustic setting.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: How rustic are we talking here? Do I need a key to use the restroom?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: I believe it refers to the decor. The photos are quite charming. A great deal of brick, and wooden fixtures.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Ok, ok. She might like it. Intimate sort of place then, and pretty close to home. Let's book it.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Right away, sir. What time and seating arrangements do you desire?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Ah, for tonight, obviously, let's say 7:30, indoor booth, for two people.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Thank you, sir. This should just take a few moments. Oh, dear. It appears that no indoor seating is available at the time you have requested.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Well, that's not great. It's like 35 degrees outside.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Would you like me to find an alternative location for the evening?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Ah, man. It's just so nice and close to home. Can we just get a later time? I think she'll be okay with anything up to nine, but no later.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Yes, sir. I'll see if we can get a later reservation time. One moment please.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Sure, take your time Larry.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Good news, Mr. Sicilia. There's a table open for 8:30 PM. Shall I place the reservation now?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: That's great, go ahead and grab it. I'm looking at the website right now too, great choice. Amy's not gonna kill me this time.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: I'm very glad we were able to find something so suitable, sir. Shall I reserve a ride service for you both as well?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: No, Larry, we'll walk. It's only like six blocks. I'm gonna take the light rail home to get ready.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Excellent, sir. Is there anything else I can do?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: No, you've been fantastic as always. Have a good night.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I need a ride right now!

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: OK great, where to and from?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I am at AC Hotel to Farm House bar

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: OK, and what time for pick up?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Right now please!

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: OK, do you want Uber or Lyft?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Let’s do Uber please

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: OK, what kind of car?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Let’s do Uber black please

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: My apologies, but only UberLUX is available right now

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: What is the UberLux fee?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: it will be $50

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: OK, that’s fine

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT

utterances.text: If possible, I would like to schedule an appointment for my car, as it is making a sharp noise seemingly coming from the engine.

segments.text: making a sharp noise seemingly coming from the engine

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Certainly, would you mind giving the make and model of the car?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: It is a 2003 Ford Mustang SVT Cobra.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: And what day and time would best suit you for this appointment?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Any time after 12PM this Monday would work.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: They can fit you in at 1PM on Monday, tomorrow. Do you mind describing the noise in greater detail.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: It is a grinding noise that occurs when I turn on the vehicle, that differs from the typical start-up rev.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: How much longer after starting up the car does this sound occur?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: It lasts anywhere from 2 more to 10 more minutes, depending on whether I begin driving.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Interesting. Was there any event that seemed to be the origin of this noise?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Well, I was driving on a mountain road outside of Detroit, and I believe that the winding turns were not good for the vehicle.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: How long has it been since this sound began?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I would say around 2 weeks, I've kept forgetting to get an appointment.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Understandable. Have you had any trouble driving the vehicle?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I have not driven it much since the incident, and will continue to not use it as much as I can.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: In the brief times you have used it, have you noticed if it is more difficult to drive the vehicle, or directly after the incident, was there any problem with turning that you experienced?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Nothing seemed amiss until I turned on the ignition the next time I wished to drive the car.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: I see, well I will reiterate this to the mechanic. That's 1PM on Monday, being tomorrow. The fee for inspection should be $100. Do you have any questions?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: That's it for me, thank you for your help.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Certainly.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I'd like to make it a large.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: I have you down for one large pizza?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: That's correct.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: What would you like on your large pizza?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I'd like to do pepperoni and olives.

utterances.text: Hey Cassidy, do you think you could purchase me two movie tickets tonight? I was wanting to take a friend to see that new Pet Sematary movie.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: I've heard it's still not as good as the original. Such a shame all the movies they keep remaking. Which location would you like the tickets for?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I agree, but my friend has been non-stop talking about it. I'm thinking the AMC over in Morrow.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Well, you'll have to give me your opinion on it when you see it. What times were you looking at, and do you want 3D or Standard?

utterances.text: I'm hoping for 8:00pm, and I'd prefer top seats. I don't know who chooses to sit at the bottom, it's such a pain in the neck.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Which store should I order it from?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: The one down Hostetter Road. It's the closest.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Alright, what size drink do you want?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Make it a grande.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Any preferences for type of milk?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Yes, ask for whole milk.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Hot or iced?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: It's hot outside so iced please.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Any toppings to add?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Nah, no toppings. That'll be all.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Okay unfortunately, they are out of whole milk. Do you want to switch the milk or order something else?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Get me a Iced Caffè Latte then

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Same size?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Yes, grande again.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Whole milk like before?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Change it to 2% milk

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Zero toppings as well?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Yep. That'll be all.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Okay, I'll place the order now

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Great, thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Alright, I've picked up the drink. The receipt will be sent via text message

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I would like to order coffee from Pete's.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Where would you like to pickup your coffee?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: 367 State St Los Altos.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: What would you like to order.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I would like one Iced Caramel Latte with soy milk.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Im sorry, soy milk is unavailable.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Do you have almond milk?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Im sorry almond milk is unavailable.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Can I order a coconut black tie instead?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Does it come with milk?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Yes, it comes with sweetened condensed milk.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: How many calories is it?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Okay. I want to order just one coconut black tie.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: I have one large coconut black tie.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Your drink order will be ready for pickup shortly. A copy of your receipt has been sent to your email.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Thanks.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Youre welcome.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Hi, I'd like an uber from Ala moana hotel to the airport

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Ala Moana Hotel to Honolulu International Airport, correct?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Yes, that's correct.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: What size uber would you prefer?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Large, we've got a lot of luggage.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: UberXL would be perfect then.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: That's fine.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: The fare will cost $62.84, is this okay?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Yep!

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: What time do you need to be picked up?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: 7:25 PM tonight.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: 7:25 PM, sure thing.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Can you book that now?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: I've booked the ride for you.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Okay, can you text me the details?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Yes, I'm texting you them now. Your driver's name is Tom and he'll be there at 7:25.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Awesome, thanks.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Was there anything else I could do for you?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Nope, that's it.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Great, have a nice day!

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Hi Shelly, I need you to schedule me an appointment with Intelligent Auto Solutions

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: No problem. What car will you be bringing in for service?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I need to bring in my 2014 Honda Civic.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Great. What would you like me to tell them in wrong with the vehicle?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: The check engine light is on

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Okay, do you want me to tell them how long the light has been on?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Yes, the light has been on for about a week.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Great. Do you have a preference on when you want to bring the vehicle in?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I want to bring it in ASAP, today if possible.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Okay, I will see what is available.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Sounds great.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: It looks like they could look at the car today at 6PM or first thing in the morning.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I need the car looked at before heading out of the town this weekend so today at 6 would be great.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Okay, I have added you to the schedule for today at 6PM

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: That is perfect.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: What contact information would you like me to provide?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Please provide may cellphone number 919-905-9000 under Brett Carmichael

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Great. Looks like the initial estimate for the appointment is $150 and I have you confirmed for today at 6PM.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Sounds great. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: You're welcome. Anything else I can do for you?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: No. That's all for now.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: This is Susie. I want to know if you would schedule an appointment for me at the auto shop?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: I'd be glad to. Which shop do you want to go to?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Oh, I can't think of the name of it. It starts with an I . . . it must start with important or --- I know, it's Intelligent. Intelligent Auto Solutions.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Is that on Ramsey street?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Yes!

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: When do you want the appointment for?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Will you see if I can get in today?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Okay. And what's the problem.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: One of the back doors won't unlock.

segments.text: One of the back doors won't unlock.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Either manually or by the automatic door unlock?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Neither. And it's a real pain. No one can get out except thru the door in traffic and that's dangerous.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Suzie, how do you spell your last name?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: M - A - R - Z - L - E - Y.

segments.text: M - A - R - Z - L - E - Y.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: And your phone number?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: 615 - 2965 in the 650 area code.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Got it. And what make and model is the car?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: 2019 Chevy Blazer.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Let me verify my information here. It's Suzie Marzley at 650-615-2965 and you want an appointment today for your 2019 Chevy Blazer. Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Hold on just a minute while I contact them . . . Mrs. Marzley?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I'm here.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: I'm sorry but they're not able to work you in today. But can you make it in tomorrow at 7:30?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I guess.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Hold on for just another minute while I grab that appointment time . . . Okay, Mrs. Marzley. You're all set for tomorrow morning at 7:30am.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Good.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: They want me to warn you not to be late, and that there will be an initial inspection fee of $55.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: That's okay, as long as they can fix it. Thanks so much for calling for me. With traffic as bad as it is, I'll be lucky if I get home before midnight.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: I'm here to assistant you anytime you need it, Mrs. Marzley. You have a good day now.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: You too. Bye.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Hi, I'm having an issue with my car can you help?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Sure, what's the problem?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: The light just came on saying that i have a headlight out.

segments.text: The light just came on saying that i have a headlight out

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: OK, when do you want to get this fixed?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Right away. Today would be ideal

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Do you already know where you want to take it?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Yes, Intelligent Auto Solutions.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: OK, let me pull up the website.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: They have an online scheduler, so you can see what they have today.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: OK, I'm there and it looks like they only have two appointments open today. Could you be there in 15 minutes?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: No, I'm at least 45 minutes away.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: OK, then the only other time would be 4 pm tonight

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Can you tell if they will be able to fix it on the spot?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: I will call and confirm. What is the make/model of your car.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I have a 2015 Kia Soul

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: OK, they said they have the parts in so you can have it done at the appointment

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: That's great news. Can you please book the 4:00?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Yes, just booked it online.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Thanks. Can you give me all the info?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Yes, I will text it to you so you'll have it all on your phone.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Thank you! This has been a big help.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Would you order me a pizza from Geno's?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Certainly, the Geno's in Mesa?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Yes please. I will pick it up on my lunch hour.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: What would you like?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: They had a specialty veggie pizza last month that was very good. I would like that again.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: What size veggie specialty pizza would you like?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: A small pie please.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Would you like thin or thick crust?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Their regular crust so thick I guess

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: So you want a flavored crust or standard?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Standard is great thanks.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Alright so one small veggie specialty pizza thick, plain crust for pick-up.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: That is correct.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: I am sorry but it looks like they are not offering the veggie specialty pizza this month. Would you like to order individual toppings?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: How disappointing. Alright order a small pizza with mushroom and green peppers then.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Do you still want the small pie with thick crust?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Yes please everything else the same with the unflavored crust.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Alright your order has been sent and confirmed.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Thank you so much

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Not a problem.  It will be ready for pickup in 25 minutes and a reciept will be sent to your phone.

segments.text: It will be ready for pickup in 25 minutes and a reciept will be sent to your phone

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I appreciate your help.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: No problem. Did you need anything else?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: That is all. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Enjoy your pizza.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Hi, I need to make an appointment with the mechanic

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Ok, do you have a prefered mechanic or should I recommend one?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: The one I went to earlier this year

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Intelligent Auto Solutions?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Yes

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Ok, what seems to be the issue?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: My engine light turned on last night, and I noticed the engine leaked some fluid overnight.

segments.text: My engine light turned on last night, and I noticed the engine leaked some fluid overnight

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Ok. Which car? Make and Model?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: My Toyota Corolla

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: The Year?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: 2012, or maybe 2013 I can't remember.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Ok. What day and time that's best?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Tomorrow

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: I see that the have an appointment tomorrow, Wednesday at 4pm.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I think it's more urgent than that, do they have anything today?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Ok, how about today between noon and 2pm?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Yes, I can go in at 1pm.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Ok. The fee for the initial inspection is $150, is that alright?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Yes

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Ok. I've booked a reservation at Intelligent Auto Solutions, 123 5th St San Francisco, for 1pm today. You'll be bringing in a 2012 or 2013 Toyota Corolla. The engine light is on and engine leaked last night. Sound good?

segments.text: The engine light is on and engine leaked last night

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Yes

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: I will send your confirmation by text. Have a good day

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Thank you

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Hi, I need you to purchase some movie tickets to the movie Aquaman.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: I sure can, what city?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: The movie theater is in Sandy, UT.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: What is the movie theater called that you would like to go to in Sandy?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: It's the Megaplex movie theater.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Great! What time would work for you? They have a 6:30pm or a 9:55pm.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I'd like to go to the 6:30 time please.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: That is a standard movie theater with no special seating such as recliners. I hope that's good with you?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Yes, that's fine.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: And how many tickets do you need?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I need two. My friend and I are going.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: That will be fun! I'll order two tickets for the 6:30 pm showing.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Thanks. Is that in 3D?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: No, it's only showing in 2D, even the later time is the same.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: OK, and how much are the tickets?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: They are $5.36 each ticket and a $2.00 service charge.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Perfect! We would like to sit towards the top middle if that's possible.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Yes, I can get you two seats on the top row. Will that work for you?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Yes it will be perfect.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Great, I've ordered the tickets. They will be sent to your phone through a message. Have fuun!

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Thank you. Bye!

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Hello Abby. The family and I want to go to Pizza Hut on Main street this afternoon and since there is normally a long wait, can you order a pizza for me?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Sure. I can most definitely do that. By the way, we love that Pizza Hut too. They have video games, many tvs and a great selection of pizzas and beer.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I know right? Yes, normally we order the supreme, but with the kids I think we are going to do something different.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Sure. What time do you want to go there?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Great question. I would like to be there with the pizza ready at 6:30 p.m. Hoping to avoid the traffic.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Great. So, what type of Pizza do you want?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Hum, Let's see. Let's go with the large supreme.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Perfect. Any thing else?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Yes, I see on their menu there is a special if you order two or more things.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: That is a good deal.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Ok. Let's get a large cheese pizza as well.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Ok. I got a large supreme and a large cheese.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: yes. Have you had the wings there? Are they frozen?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: No, I haven't in the past they were not that good. I worked at a Pizza Hut in college and they were frozen.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Ok. Then, I see they have pasta bowls. I would like to add a regular size pasta bowl with alfredo sauce.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Ok. So you want the large supreme and cheese and the pasta bowl.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Yes, that is it. Perfect. Ok.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: The order should be ready when you arrive at 6:30 p.m.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Thank you so much.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: your pizza order is complete and the pizzas will be ready for pickup in about 25 minutes.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Hello, I would like to reserve a table at the Italian Restaurant in Boise, Idaho.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Hello, I can help you with that. Please give me a second.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: No worries, take your time.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Thank you. What date and time do you want to have your table reservation?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I would like to reserve it this evening at 5:00pm.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Give me a second to check. Is for indoor?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Yes, I would like indoor.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Sorry there is no table available at that time.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: How about another restaurant, try Greek Food in Boise, Idaho.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: I will check that for you, please give me a second.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: No

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: No problem.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Yes it is available at that restaurant.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: How many people are coming?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I have 7 people.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Sorry, there is no table available at that time. Try a later time.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: How about 7:00pm for indoor.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: That works! There is an indoor table for 7 people available at this new restaurant.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Thank you!

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: You are welcome!

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Hey! Have a favor to ask.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Whatever you need!

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I need you to make an appointment for my car again.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: No problem, same place as last time?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Yes, Intelligent Auto Solutions.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Okay, I have their number saved already. Whats going on?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: It is for my 2009 Mercury Mariner.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: What is the problem with it?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I think it might need a new transmission. I am not sure.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Okay, I am on their site now. What time would you like to take it by?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: As soon as possible.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: They do not have anything else open today. Would you like me to see if you can bring in the AM?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: No, that won't work. I need it done by tomorrow evening.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Okay, I can see if it can be dropped off before they close. That should be fine.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: That would work. Hopefully they can get it done in time.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: I have confirmed that you can bring it by tonight before they close.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: That is awesome. ETA on when it could be done?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Should be able to pick it back up by the end of tomorrow. Is that alright?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Okay, so you can drop it off tonight and leave the keys with them. I will call a car to pick you up as well. The transmission needs to be checked and for that it is a $65 fee.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Perfect! You're the best.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Anytime!

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I'm looking for a good seafood restaurant to take some visiting family.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: I suggest The Marina Cafe.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: That sounds good. Please make me a reservation for Saturday evening, March 23.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: What time and how many people?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: 7 pm is good. There will be four of us.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Any special requests?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Do they have outdoor seating?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Yes, would you like that if available?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Yes please.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: There are no tables available in or outdoor for Saturday, March 23 at 7 pm.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: What about 7:30 pm?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: No, I'm sorry. The only available tables for that date are at 5 pm and 9 pm.

utterances.speaker: USER

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: ill go to the town talk place

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: okay when

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: id like to go on tuesday the 2nd

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: what time

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: at 4:00pm

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: okay how many people do you think will be going

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: probably only about 5

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: how special thing youd like

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: yeah can we be outside as well

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Il see if you can get a table there

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: okay thank you

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: yeah they dont having anymore available

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: damn, well can we just get a booth then

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: well i guess ill check

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: sweet thanks again man

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: and they dont have any of them available either im sorry

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: well we can just go to fogo de chow then

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: okay sweet ill contact them right now

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: let me know please

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: they can have you on tuesday at 4:00 like you wanted

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: nice thats good to know

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: they will also have a booth outside!

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: thats great news!

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Your welcome well see you soon

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I need to book a reservation for my husband's birthday. I'm thinking something casual but with good food. Maybe a pub of some sort? He's a burgers and pizza kind of guy.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Do you have a place in mind?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Not really. I wanna try a new place. Somewhere nearby.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Okay. I've found a pub with great reviews. Excellent service, fantastic food. Looks promising, and it's only 15 minutes away.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Alright. Let's try that.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Booking it now. What time?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: This saturday at 7:30 PM.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: They don't have that available. Is 8 PM alright?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Sure. That should be fine.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Okay. How many people?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Ten.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Got it. Outdoor or indoor?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Indoor.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Do you guys wanna be at the bar?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Nah.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Booth or table?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: He prefers booths, but let's do a table. Easier, given how many people are going.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Kay.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Do they have valet parking?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Hm. I don't believe so. It doesn't say.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Alright. No problem.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: It's booked. Is that all?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Yup! That's it. Thanks!

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: You're welcome. Bye.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Bye.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Hey I need an Uber ride?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Sure, where would you like to be picked up and dropped off at?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Give me estimates for fair from 100 Espanas Glen to Regal Cinemas 16 in Escondido.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Sure, let me look. The cheapest fair price is $6.32.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: What are the other ride options?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Pooling is $6.32, UberX is $6.65, and UberXL is $8.96

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: How many other riders share a pool?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Uber's estimates show 1-2 other people.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: How long is the wait on average?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Hmm, there is no estimation until you book a ride in the app.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Can you book a pool ride for me now?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Let's see...There is no available Economy Pool drivers available at this time. Would you like to try Uber X or XL?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: How do the prices compare to Lyft estimates?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Shared and personal rides are comparably the same at $4-8.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Is there a base fare ride available from Lyft at this time?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: There is a driver near you with one other passenger

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Place the request on the app for me at my location.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Ok, I'll do that now. It should be going to your mobile device as a text confirmation.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Ok thanks. Goodbye

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: No problem. Goodbye.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I feel like eating at a nice restaurant tonight.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Okay. Let's see what restaurants are nearby.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I am interested in Italian restaurants.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: That's Amore gets good reviews.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Nah, the lines are always too long there.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Okay. How about Santinos?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: That sounds good.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: What time should I book tonight?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Make a reservation for two people with a river view at 6:30PM.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Okay. It appears that is not available then?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: What times are available?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Seven is the closest time available.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Okay book that.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: All right. You are all booked. Would you like to include valet parking?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Okay. There is a notification that due to high demand, there might be extra wait times.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Oh well. They have good food.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Yeah they do.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: It'll be worth it.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Hi Sally, I need a Grande iced Americano with soy milk please.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Okay, I'll give the local store a call.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Okay, when should I pick it up?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Unfortunately they can't do that drink for you.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Why not???

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: They don't have soy milk available and they only have venti cups.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Shoot. Okay, let me think.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Take your time, miss.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Alright, do they have any tall cups?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Yes, they said that they have tall and venti.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I thought you just said venti.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Nope, I just checked again and they have both tall and venti.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Okay, what kind of milk do they have?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: They have oat, coconut, almond, skim, 2%, and whole milk

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Okay I'll have a tall iced americano with almond milk.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Just letting you know the almond milk did not sit well with your stomach last time.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Oh my gosh, you're right. Thanks for reminding me.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: No problem. What milk then?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I'll go with coconut milk.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Perfect! It will be ready for you at the times square 43rd street location of Starbucks.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Good afternoon. I would like to order a pizza today.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Where would you like to order from?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Grand Pizza in Las Vegas, NV

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: What size pizza would you like?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: A 16 inch one

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Create your own or specialty

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Create your own

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: What toppings would you like?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Chicken and beef please.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: I'm sorry. They do not have beef available. Would you like a different topping?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Yes.  Chicken and feta cheese

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Ok. Would you like to order anything else?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: No thank you.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Ok. So you would like a 16 inch pizza with chicken and feta cheese. Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Yes it is.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Is this for delivery or carryout?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Carryout please.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Ok. Will that be all for today?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Yes. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Your pizza order is complete and your order will be ready for pick up in 25 minutes. Your receipt will be emailed to you.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Have a wonderful afternoon.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Hey. I'm thinking of seeing What Men Want tonight. Would you mind ordering some tickets?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Not at all. I've heard good things about that one. Where are you going to see it?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: The United Artists Denver Pavilions 15 is my favorite local theater. They have the most comfortable seats.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: I agree. They really are the best. What time is the show?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: It looks like we're late for the earlier show, so the only option will be 10:50pm. That's okay, I had a nap today.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: That is late. But I'm sure it will be worth staying up for.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: My wife really wants to see it too.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Okay, so how many tickets should I order?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Just two please.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: No problem. So two tickets for the 10:55 show for What Men Want?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I think it was 10:50. But yes.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Okay, sorry. My mistake. I will get on that right now.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Thank you so much!

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: It appears you have to choose your seats in advance. There are plenty available. Where would you like to sit?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Somewhere in the upper-middle section sounds good.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Okay I will look for something close to the middle.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Wonderful.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Great. The tickets have been purchased. They will be sent your phone in a text message. Let me know if you have received them.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Just got the text! Thanks so much.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: No problem. Anytime.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Hello. Can you help me purchase a couple of movie tickets?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: I can definitely do that. Tell me what you had in mind.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I'd like to see Captain Marvel at the NCG Cinemas in Midland Michigan. If possible, I'd like two tickets for the 6pm show in 3d.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Ok. Let me see if I can do that for you.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Ok.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Looks like they aren't showing it in 3D.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Ok. Can I get the tickets for just the regular viewing at the same time?

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: I'll check on that.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Thanks.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Looks like they're sold out. The only available time is 9:15pm.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: Oh no. I don't think that will work. That's much too late.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Is there something else I can do for you? Maybe a different movie?

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: No I don't think so.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Are you sure? They have several other movies showing around 6pm tonight.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: No. We really wanted to see that movie.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Ok.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I think we'll pass for tonight. Thanks anyhow.

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: Ok. Just let me know if you change your mind.

utterances.speaker: USER
utterances.text: I will. Thanks

utterances.speaker: ASSISTANT
utterances.text: No problem!
